DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住まいについてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about housing, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分が管理する空き家の庭木が、隣の歩道へ伸びています。剪定の相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 管理する空き家の歩道へ伸びた庭木を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The trees in the garden of a vacant house I manage are growing out over the neighboring sidewalk. I would like advice about pruning them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about garden trees at a vacant house you manage that extend over the sidewalk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 建物の所在地と、枝が出ている場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the building's address and where the branches are sticking out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この住所です。門の横の木で、歩く人の顔の高さまで枝が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所と枝の高さ場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the address. It is the tree beside the gate, and its branches extend out at the height of pedestrians' faces.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the address and the location and height of the branches. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現状の写真があれば、相談の際にお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you have photographs of the current condition, please show them when you seek advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日撮りました。作業を頼める業者の情報と、相談窓口を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真を示し業者情報と相談先を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I took some yesterday. I would like information about contractors who can do the work and the office I should consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the photographs and ask for contractor information and the appropriate consultation office. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当窓口をご案内します。市が直接剪定をするかどうかも、そこで説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will direct you to the responsible office. They will also explain whether the city does the pruning itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で管理を依頼する必要もあるのですね。市の作業日を予約するつもりで来ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 市が剪定すると思っていた認識を修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I may need to arrange for someone to maintain it myself. I came here intending to book a day for the city to do the work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct your understanding that the city would do the pruning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望と現状を担当へお伝えください。業者への依頼内容を整理する資料もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the responsible staff what you would like and the current situation. We also have material to help organize what to ask a contractor to do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料をください。住所と写真を持って担当に相談し、見積りを取る準備に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 業者見積り準備の資料と担当相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please give me that material. I will take the address and photographs to the responsible staff for advice and use it to prepare to obtain estimates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for material to prepare for contractor estimates and for advice from the responsible staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、住宅の相談担当へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the housing consultation staff, then. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 身の回りのことで、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having difficulty with your personal care?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 髪を洗いたいです。今は浴室へ行けないので、病室で手伝ってもらう方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 浴室へ行けない中で病室洗髪の支援方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to wash my hair. I cannot go to the bathroom at the moment. Is there a way to get help doing it in my hospital room?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to get help washing your hair in your hospital room when you cannot go to the bathroom. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日できるケアを担当と確認します。ご自分で動かしにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the staff in charge about what care is possible today. Are there any parts of your body you find difficult to move yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右肩を上げづらいです。左手なら動かせますが、髪全体を洗うのは難しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右肩挙上困難と左手使用可及び全体洗髪困難を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is difficult to raise my right shoulder. I can move my left hand, but washing all my hair is difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that raising your right shoulder is difficult, you can use your left hand, and you cannot easily wash all your hair. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ確認しました。今日はベッドで洗髪の支援ができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked with the staff in charge. We can help you wash your hair in bed today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。髪が長いので、結んでいるゴムを先に外します。頭を支える動作は手伝ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 洗髪支援を希望し結髪を外して頭部支えを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. My hair is long, so I will take out the hair tie first. Please help me with supporting my head.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request help washing your hair, remove the hair tie, and ask for help supporting your head. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 首の位置を見ながら準備します。顔に水がかからないよう、こちらのタオルを使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will prepare while checking the position of your neck. We will use this towel to keep water off your face.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: タオルは左手で持てます。濡れる前に、枕元の本をかばんへしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 左手タオル保持と本の収納準備を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can hold the towel with my left hand. Before anything gets wet, I will put the book beside my pillow into my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you can hold the towel with your left hand and will put your book away first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備ができました。洗った後は、職員が乾かすお手伝いもします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Everything is ready. After washing, the staff will also help dry your hair.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乾かす所までお願いします。左手でできることは自分でし、肩がつらくなったら声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乾燥支援及び可能動作は本人が行い疼痛時申告を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please help me through the drying as well. I will do what I can with my left hand and let you know if my shoulder starts to hurt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for help drying your hair, say you will do what you can yourself, and report any pain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご様子を確認しながら始めます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will begin while checking how you are doing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらでお話を伺います。今、相手は近くにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will listen to you here. Is that person nearby now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅から同じ人が後ろを歩いてきて、怖くなってここへ入りました。入口からは見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 後方の人を恐れ警察署へ入り現在見えないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The same person followed behind me from the station, and I got scared and came in here. I cannot see them from the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you became afraid of the person behind you, entered the police station, and cannot see them now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追いかけられたと感じた経過を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what happened that made you feel you were being followed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二度道を曲がっても後ろにいました。最後に「待って」と声を掛けられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二度の曲がり道と呼び掛けの経過を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They were still behind me even after I turned twice. At the end they called out, “Wait.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the two turns and the person calling out to you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手の顔や服装で覚えていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you remember anything about their face or clothes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 灰色の上着と赤い帽子です。顔ははっきり見ていませんが、声は低かったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 服装と顔未確認及び声の特徴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They wore a gray jacket and a red hat. I did not get a clear look at their face, but their voice was low.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe their clothes, explain that you did not clearly see their face, and describe their voice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お体にけがはありますか。何か触られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any injuries? Did they touch you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 触られてはいません。帰り道にもまた会いそうで、このまま一人で出るのが不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 接触けがなしと単独帰宅への不安を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They did not touch me. I feel I might encounter them again on the way home, so I am anxious about leaving alone like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that there was no physical contact or injury and that you are anxious about going home alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の状況を確認し、安全について担当と相談します。帰る方向も伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the current situation and discuss your safety with the staff in charge. Could you also tell us which direction you are going home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東側の団地です。家の詳しい場所は、こちらの地図を使ってお伝えします。帰る方法も相談させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰宅方向を示し地図による説明と安全相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The housing complex on the east side. I will explain the exact location of my home using this map. Please also let me discuss how to get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Indicate your direction home, offer to explain using a map, and ask for advice about getting home safely. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。続きは担当と一緒に伺いますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will listen to the rest together with the staff in charge. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現金をお送りになるご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about sending cash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 祖母へ一万円を送りたいです。手元の普通の封筒ではなく、専用の封筒を使うのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祖母への一万円を専用封筒で送る方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to send 10,000 yen to my grandmother. Do I use a special envelope rather than the ordinary envelope I have with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to send 10,000 yen to your grandmother using a special envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの現金用の封筒をご案内します。中に入れる金額も申告していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will show you this envelope for cash. You will also need to declare the amount you put inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この封筒を一枚ください。中は一万円札一枚で、カードも同封したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 専用封筒一枚購入と一万円札及びカード同封を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please give me one of these envelopes. I will put in one 10,000-yen note, and I would also like to enclose a card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to buy one special envelope and enclose a 10,000-yen note and a card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カードも入ります。宛名と差出人を書いてから、こちらの閉じ方をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can enclose the card as well. After writing the recipient's and sender's details, please look at how to seal it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方を書きました。内側と外側の二つのふたを、どの順番で閉じますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名差出人記入後に二つのふたの順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written both. In which order do I close the inner and outer flaps?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After writing the recipient's and sender's details, ask which order to close the two flaps. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内側を先に閉じてから、外側を閉じます。封の部分はこちらでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Close the inner flap first, then the outer flap. Please check the sealing area here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お札とカードを入れ、二つのふたを順に閉じました。印を付ける場所も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金銭カードを入れ順に閉じ封印位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have put in the note and card and closed the two flaps in order. Please also show me where to put the seal marks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you enclosed the cash and card and closed the flaps in order, and ask where to put the seal marks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの印の位置です。記入後に料金と引受けの案内をご確認いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: These are the locations for the marks. After completing them, please check the information on charges and acceptance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 印を付けました。申告額一万円で、封筒と取扱いの料金を合わせて支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封印と一万円申告及び総料金支払いを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put the marks on. With a declared amount of 10,000 yen, I will pay the envelope and handling charges together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request sealing, declaration of 10,000 yen, and payment of the total charges. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、封筒をお預かりしてご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will take your envelope and guide you through the process. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 硬貨のご入金をご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to deposit coins, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 貯金箱の中身を入金したいです。旅行先の硬貨も入っているので、先に分ける場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貯金箱内の円と外国硬貨を仕分ける机を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to deposit the contents of my money box. There are also coins from my travels in it. Is there somewhere to separate them first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a table to sort the Japanese and foreign coins in your money box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの机をご利用ください。円の硬貨だけを入金するご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use this table. Are you asking about depositing only the yen coins?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。外国の硬貨は持ち帰ります。似た大きさなので、表の文字を見ながら分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外国硬貨は持帰り文字で分類したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I will take the foreign coins home. They are similar in size, so I would like to sort them by looking at the writing on the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will take the foreign coins home and would like to sort them by their writing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 枚数によって取扱いや手数料が変わるため、円の硬貨の枚数もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The procedure and fees vary with the number of coins, so please also tell us how many yen coins there are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分けたら四十六枚でした。金額だけ数えればよいと思っていましたが、枚数も書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 円硬貨四十六枚と枚数記載を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: After separating them, there were forty-six. I thought I only needed to count the amount of money, but I will write down the number of coins too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that there are forty-six yen coins and that you will record the number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お客様の口座への入金でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is this a deposit into your own account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の普通預金です。外国の硬貨は別の袋へ戻しましたので、こちらの四十六枚だけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人普通預金への円硬貨だけの入金を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Into my own ordinary savings account. I have put the foreign coins back into a separate bag, so please deposit only these forty-six coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a deposit of only the yen coins into your own ordinary savings account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が枚数と手数料を確認します。ご案内後に入金を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff in charge will check the number and the fees. We will proceed with the deposit after explaining them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 費用の説明を聞いてからお願いします。受取りの控えに金額が出たら、通帳と一緒に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 費用説明後の入金と控え保管を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do it after I hear the explanation of the costs. Once the amount is shown on the receipt, I will take it home with my passbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to make the deposit after the fee explanation and say you will keep the receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、この硬貨と通帳をお持ちになって窓口へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take these coins and your passbook to the counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ドレッシングの試食はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to sample some dressing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 生野菜用を探しています。酸っぱい物は少し苦手なので、二種類を少量ずつ比べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 酸味が苦手と二種少量試食を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for one for raw vegetables. I am not very fond of sour foods, so could I compare small amounts of two kinds?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are not fond of sour flavors and ask to sample small amounts of two kinds. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらはレモン風味、もう一つはごま風味です。野菜にそれぞれかけてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one is lemon flavored and the other is sesame flavored. I will put each on vegetables for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まずレモン風味をいただきます。どのくらいの味か知りたいので、野菜を何も付けずに一口食べてから試してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先に無調味野菜を試しレモン味と比べる方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will try the lemon one first. To find out how it tastes, may I take a bite of the vegetables without anything on them before trying it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to try unseasoned vegetables first and compare them with the lemon flavor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 何もかけていない野菜もこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We also have vegetables here with nothing on them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 比べるとレモンの酸味が強く感じます。次に、ごま風味を同じ野菜で試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レモン酸味を述べ同野菜でごま味を試したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: By comparison, the lemon tastes quite sour to me. Next I would like to try the sesame flavor with the same vegetables.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Comment on the lemon's sourness and ask to try sesame on the same vegetables. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらをどうぞ。販売用は小さい瓶と大きい瓶があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here you are. The dressing for sale comes in small and large bottles.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ごま風味の方が好みです。初めて買うので小さい瓶にします。瓶は振ってから使うと書いてありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ごまの好みと小瓶選択及び振る表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I prefer the sesame flavor. It is my first purchase, so I will choose a small bottle. It says to shake the bottle before use, doesn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your preference for sesame, choose a small bottle, and check the instruction to shake it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、使い方はその表示をご覧ください。小さい瓶はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please see that label for the directions. The small bottles are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示も読みました。このごま風味の小さい瓶を買います。味を比べて選べましたので、試食の容器はこちらへ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示確認後ごま小瓶購入と試食容器返却を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have read the label too. I will buy this small bottle of sesame dressing. Sampling helped me compare and choose, so I will return the sample container here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you checked the label, will buy a small sesame bottle, and will return the sample container. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どうぞお会計へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please proceed to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鳥をご覧になる場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a place to watch birds?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 双眼鏡を持ってきました。車いすで入れる場所から、池の鳥を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車いすで池の鳥を双眼鏡観察できる場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought binoculars. I would like to watch the birds on the pond from a place accessible by wheelchair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a wheelchair-accessible place to watch pond birds through binoculars. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 北側の観察台は階段があります。南側の通路なら池を見渡せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The observation platform on the north side has stairs. You can overlook the pond from the path on the south side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 観察台へ上がる必要はないのですね。南側へは舗装された道で行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 観察台を使わず舗装路利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I do not need to go up to the observation platform. Can I get to the south side on a paved path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about using a paved path without going up to the observation platform. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 舗装路がありますが、池の手前は少し傾斜しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a paved path, but there is a slight slope before the pond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で押しているので、急な下りは避けたいです。傾斜の手前にも止まれる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単独移動のため急傾斜前の観察候補を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I propel myself, so I would like to avoid a steep descent. Is there somewhere to stop before the slope as well?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a possible observation spot before the steep slope because you are moving independently. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路の広い部分からも池の一部が見えます。地図でお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also see part of the pond from the wide section of the path. I will show you on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここなら傾斜へ入らず見られますね。双眼鏡で探して、遠い鳥もそこから観察します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図の平坦候補から遠い鳥を見ると選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: From here I can watch without going onto the slope. I will use my binoculars to look for birds and watch the distant ones from there too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the level spot on the map to watch distant birds. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移動する方が通れる幅を残してご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please leave enough width for other people to pass when using the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路の端に寄り、後ろの人が通れるようにします。今日はその場所までの往復にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通行幅を残しその場所への往復を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will stay at the edge of the path so people behind me can pass. Today I will just go to that spot and back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave space for others to pass and only travel to that spot and back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ観察をお楽しみください。お気をつけて行ってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy watching the birds. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札を出る前のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking for advice before leaving through the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 寝過ごして一駅先まで来ました。まだ改札は出ていませんが、目的の駅へ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一駅寝過ごしたと改札未退出を伝え戻り方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I fell asleep and went one station too far. I have not left through the gates yet, but I would like to go back to my intended station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you slept past your stop by one station, have not left the gates, and ask how to return. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの切符と、予定していた駅を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your ticket and the station where you intended to get off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この切符です。降りるはずだった駅はこちらで、乗った列車は今発車しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符目的駅と列車発車済を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is my ticket. This is the station where I should have got off, and the train I was on has just departed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your ticket and intended station and say the train has already departed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 戻る時の運賃と乗車方法を確認します。次の予定の時刻はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the fare and the procedure for returning. Is there a time for your next appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待合せが十時です。相手へ遅れる連絡をしてから戻る列車を教えてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十時待合せへの遅刻連絡後に列車案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am meeting someone at ten. After telling them I will be late, I would like you to tell me which train to take back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will notify someone that you will be late for a ten o'clock meeting, then ask for train information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 精算の担当はこちらです。戻る列車は、その後の発車案内で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The fare adjustment staff are here. After that, you can check the returning train on the departure information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手には遅れると送りました。元の切符をそのまま使えると考えず、ここで精算をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅刻連絡を報告し戻るための精算を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have sent a message saying I will be late. Rather than assume I can use the original ticket as it is, I would like to settle the fare here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you sent the late-arrival message and request fare adjustment for the return. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が切符を確認します。戻った駅では改札を出る予定ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will check your ticket. You intend to leave through the gates at the station you return to, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。そこで降りて待合せ場所へ向かいます。案内された方法の切符を持って、戻るホームへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻った駅で降り案内に従うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will get off there and go to the meeting place. I will take the ticket for the procedure I am instructed to follow and go to the return platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will get off at the station you return to and follow the instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、まずこちらの窓口へどうぞ。お気をつけてお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to this counter first. Take care on your return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明会へのお申込みですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to register for the information session, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 参加します。配られる資料の文字が小さいと読みづらいので、大きな文字の版があれば欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明会資料の大文字版を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will attend. Small print in the handouts is difficult for me to read, so I would like a large-print version if there is one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a large-print version of the information session handouts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙とデータの、どちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you prefer paper or data?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙が使いやすいです。画面を見ながら話を聞くより、紙へメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面より紙へのメモが使いやすいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Paper is easier for me to use. Rather than look at a screen while listening, I would like to make notes on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that taking notes on paper is easier than using a screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ準備できるか確認します。会場での受取りをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the staff in charge whether we can prepare it. Would you like to collect it at the venue?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 事前に読んでおきたいので、可能なら前日までに窓口で受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前日までの窓口受取り希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to read it beforehand, so if possible I would like to collect it at the counter by the day before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you would like to collect it at the counter by the day before. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 準備できる日を確認してご案内します。図も大きい方がよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check which day it can be ready and let you know. Would you also like the diagrams enlarged?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 地図の線も見えにくいので、図もお願いします。白黒で構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図も拡大し白黒でよいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The map lines are also hard to see, so please enlarge the diagrams too. Black and white is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you would also like the maps enlarged and that black and white is fine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を申込みへ添えます。連絡をお受けになる方法はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will add those requests to your application. These are the ways you can receive our reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 窓口からの電話を選びます。受取り日を聞いてから来るようにし、今日は参加の申込みだけ済ませます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話連絡と参加申込み後の受取りを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose a phone call from the counter. I will come after learning the collection date, and today I will just complete my registration for the session.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose telephone notification and collection after registering for the session. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 参加と資料のご希望を承りました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received your registration and your request for the material. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬について、困っていることがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything about your medicine that you are having difficulty with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 処方された錠剤が大きくて、飲むときに喉につかえる感じがあります。別の形にできるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きい錠剤のつかえ感と別剤形の相談を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The prescribed tablets are large, and they feel as though they get stuck in my throat when I swallow them. I would like to ask whether a different form is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention the sensation of large tablets sticking and ask about a different dosage form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 薬の名前と、飲んだ時の様子を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask the name of the medicine and what happened when you took it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この袋の薬です。昨日は飲めましたが、途中で何度も水を飲みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薬袋と昨日の服用時の様子を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the medicine in this bag. I managed to take it yesterday, but had to drink water many times along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the medicine bag and describe what happened when you took it yesterday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 形を変えられるかは、医師や薬剤師が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The doctor or pharmacist will check whether its form can be changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 錠剤を割ればよいと思いましたが、まだ割っていません。粉にすることも相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未分割と粉薬への変更希望を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought I could split the tablets, but I have not done so yet. Could I also ask about having them made into powder?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not split the tablets and ask about changing to powder. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望も伝えます。今まで粉薬を飲んだことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass on that request too. Have you taken powdered medicine before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。苦くても飲めました。今回の薬で使える形を説明してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 粉薬経験と今回利用可能な形の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I could take it even when it was bitter. I would like an explanation of which forms are available for this medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention your experience of powdered medicine and ask for an explanation of forms available for this medicine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お薬の袋を担当へお見せします。飲み方も一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show the medicine bag to the staff in charge. Let us check how to take it as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。大きさが理由で困っていると伝えて、変更が決まったら次に受け取る薬と飲み方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大きさによる困難をまとめ変更後薬と飲み方確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. Please explain that the size is what is causing me difficulty. If a change is decided, I will check the medicine I receive next and how to take it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the difficulty caused by the size and ask to check the replacement medicine and how to take it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当へおつなぎします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will put you in touch with the staff in charge. Excuse me.
